The Race — Standard (1%)

1% risk per trade

Each lane is an independent virtual account, risk fixed at 1%. How the crown works

▾

Risk stays fixed — it never compounds. The 🏆 crown only goes to a target with at least 10 trades logged — and never to a target that has failed, no matter its profit.

—

1:2.5 — · — WR — trades FAILED— DD
1:3 — · — WR — trades FAILED— DD
1:3.5 — · — WR — trades FAILED— DD
1:4 — · — WR — trades FAILED— DD

Drawdown is measured against the 10% max-drawdown limit on this strategy ($1,000 on a $10,000 start) — a target flips to Failed once its loss actually crosses that line, and stays Failed even if it later recovers.

Every calendar month with at least one resolved trade is shown — small-sample months (just a few trades) can look misleadingly clean, so weigh trade count alongside win rate. Net $ applies each trade's own logged risk size to the hypothetical target's R outcome — an estimate, not a second real-outcome figure.

Best Days of the Week

▾

Same idea as Best Periods, one level more granular — win rate by weekday.

DayTradesW / LWin RateNet R
Loading…

The 🏆 only goes to a day with at least 10 resolved trades logged — days below that are still shown (dimmed, with their trade count) so the data isn't hidden, just not crowned off a small sample. Days spanning more than one year get a ▸ — tap the row to see that day's win rate broken out by year. A ▲/▼ next to the win rate compares the last 90 days against that day's all-time number (shown once there's at least 5 recent trades to judge it by).

Top Combinations

CombinationTradesW / LWin RateProfitLossNet P/L
Loading…

Scored per strategy — a combo's win rate only reflects trades logged under the Strategy selected in the sticky bar at the top of the page, since the same tags can behave differently across different strategies. Combos of 2 up to 5 confluences (whatever a trade actually carries, capped at 5) need at least 15 trades to be ranked — below that they're folded into an "Other combos" bucket instead of showing a misleadingly clean win rate. Each row is tagged "N-way" so a 3-way combo's edge isn't mistaken for a 2-way pair nested inside it. Only the top 10 qualifying combos (by Net P/L) are shown individually; the rest are folded into "Other qualifying combos."

Development vs. Validation

▾

Splits the Strategy selected above into an earlier "development" period and a later "validation" period, so you can check whether its edge holds up on trades it wasn't unconsciously curve-fitted to. Figures are R-based at the R:R target selected at the top of the page, same convention as the rest of this page.

Data & Backup

▾

Export Trades (CSV)

A spreadsheet of your trades — for taxes, or to share with a mentor. This is a readable snapshot, not a backup: it won't include strategies, confluences, or timeframes, and can't be loaded back in.

Export Report (PDF)

A formatted summary — win rate, net R, per-strategy breakdown — followed by the trade log, ready to print or save as a PDF. Opens in a new tab; use your browser's Print → Save as PDF.

Backup All Data (JSON)

Everything in this account — trades, strategies, confluences, and timeframes — in a file you can restore from later. Keep this somewhere safe as an independent copy of your data.

Restore from Backup

Load a backup file created above. Trades are matched by ID: anything in the file updates or adds to what's already here — nothing already in this account gets deleted. Strategies, confluences, and timeframes are merged the same way, by name.
